work: Nonrivalry and the Economics of Data

model_or_identification: dynamic growth model; consumption generates data; data enters production nonrivally

work: A Model of the Data Economy

model_or_identification: dynamic data stock; transactions generate data; data raises predictive precision; storage and depreciation
